subject: POC kickoff: NimbusHealth - scheduling and owners

Subject: POC kickoff - NimbusHealth (AE + SE + security/procurement)

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo earlier — leadership is keen to move to a short POC to validate latency and integration with our data pipeline. We need to schedule a 60–90 minute kickoff that includes: AE (you), SE (technical deep-dive), our infra/IT ops, and someone from procurement to outline contracting/timeline expectations. Security might join for the network/whitelisting part.

Our tentative goals for the kickoff:
- Align on POC success criteria (latency targets, test dataset, telemetry/observability)
- Confirm timeline and owners for deployment/access
- Discuss procurement timeline and any compliance docs needed (SOC2, data residency)

Available windows next week (Pacific):
- Tue 2026-11-03: 10:00–12:00 or 15:00–16:30
- Wed 2026-11-04: 09:00–11:00
- Thu 2026-11-05: 13:00–16:00

Please loop in any SEs and let me know who from procurement we should expect so I can get them on the invite.

Thanks,
Sara
Sara Lee
Director, Engineering Operations
NimbusHealth

Ethan/Dev — do either of the windows below work for a 75-minute kickoff? We’ll plan for: 20m product overview + 40–45m technical deep-dive (including network/whitelist and test-data access) + 10–15m success criteria & next steps. I attached a short agenda (nimbus_poc_agenda_v1.pdf) for your review.

Proposed times (PT):
- Wed 2026-11-04 at 09:30
- Thu 2026-11-05 at 14:00

Sara — also helpful if you can confirm:
- Who is the procurement contact (name + email)?
- Any security questionnaire already started (we can bring our SOC2 summary)
- If you expect a production replica dataset for the POC or sanitized sample data

We can be flexible if procurement needs a different day — thinking of blocking Wed morning and Thu afternoon until we lock.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole

marissa_cole@redwood.com

Subject: Re: POC kickoff - NimbusHealth (AE + SE + security/procurement)

Marissa / Sara — I can do Wed 11/04 at 09:30 PT.

Quick notes on SE prep and suggested success criteria so we can get alignment before the meeting:
- Pre-reqs:
  - Network: list of egress IPs and any firewall rules for our dedicated POC nodes (if you want a private deployment).
  - Credentials: service account or temporary credentials for the test data bucket (read-only preferred).
- Proposed technical success criteria (confirm with your team):
  1) Latency: p99 generation latency < 350ms for 512-token context on our tuned model under expected QPS.
  2) Throughput: sustained 20 RPS with tail latencies within SLO.
  3) Integration: ability to call Redwood API from your pipeline and push logs/traces to your APM (we’ll provide example instrumentation).
  4) Observability: token-level cost breakdown and per-route latency visible in the console for the test traffic.

Attendees we recommend on the Redwood side: myself (SE), Dev (solutions), and I can bring an implementation engineer if we need to do live network troubleshooting.

I’ll review the agenda and add a 10-minute block for whitelisting and network checks.

—Ethan
Ethan Park
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ethan_park@redwood.com
